notes: Values were checked on the skill's own page only where 'src' points to it (lucky-seven, double-stab, drain, savage-blow, steal). Other skills come from the class listing pages, which show only the max level, an 'Unlocks at Lv N' label and a short description.

Prerequisites: two are stated on skill pages (drain needs critical-recovery Lv 3; steal needs haste Lv 5), and both match the 'Unlocks at Lv N' label on the listing. The other prereqs (keen-eyes, dark-sight, critical-throw, claw-booster, dagger-booster) are inferred from that label plus the pre-Big Bang skill tree; the listing does not name the parent skill.

Not confirmed (not shown on the pages fetched): MP costs for buffs/boosters/dark-sight/disorder; the stat values of nimble-body, keen-eyes (other than its +200 range, from the Lucky Seven page), disorder, masteries, boosters, critical-throw, critical-recovery and nimble-recovery; Bandit Haste values (Assassin Haste listing gives Speed +30, Jump +10, 300 s).
Lucky Seven page: uses a fixed 3.0 weapon multiplier and a fixed 50% mastery (Claw Mastery does not apply), damage scales with LUK. Classic change: max-level damage 120% -> 140% (2026-08-04).
Drain Classic change: COT1 absorbed 15% of damage on every hit; COT2 onward it procs at 12% chance (2026-08-04). Current value used.
Steal Classic changes: damage 200% -> 180% and targets 1 -> 2 (2026-08-04); Attack Power buff 30 s -> 60 s (COT2 -> launch, 2026-10-06). dmgPct 180 comes from the change log, not the max-level table.
Savage Blow hits step up with level: 4 hits (Lv 1-10), 5 (Lv 11-20), 6 (Lv 21-30); per-hit damage cycles 65% -> 75% within each band.
Steal was read from NiaDB's Spanish-locale skill page because the English URL was not reachable; numbers are the same across locales.
